Task ID
IMP-34

Title
Build the connected PPAP workspace

Category
Screens and navigation

Objective
Let users work through scope, elements, evidence and discussion in one responsive browser workspace.

Detailed scope
Change only target branches of the verified PPAP/APQP/task views, replacing obsolete product/template/PSW/interim panels with the target scope, warrant, element, evidence/history and discussion controls. Keep historical rendering and server-side permissions separate.

Deliverable
Target PPAP workspace and narrow originating navigation changes for desktop, tablet and phone.

IMP-04 — Set up PPAP issue and approval facts

• IMP-12 provides the engineering-release/source-part/review fields and preparation forms.

• IMP-19 provides the prepared requirement-set generator and validation operation.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: known target layout and named controls can proceed against the package views; final connections wait only where the effective tenant view/action differs.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Changes to the existing setup
APQP_PPAP_Detail (ee3fad4b-3787-45b3-a463-9f6f9ba01364; /GraphData/Items/812)
The exported create/detail view requires singular Product/legacy Template and contains old project/contributor/task/PSW and edit-read-only paths. Add a Target Configuration? branch with scope/parts/elements/saved evidence/schedule/history/discussion and the new explicit actions; remove old mandatory Product/template and legacy PSW/interim controls from that branch. Retain historic rendering.

APQP_APQP_Detail (e008a361-a8c3-4d36-8df6-3ff2434d6d75)
Keep APQP gates/task behavior. Add only scoped target PPAP launch/navigation and visible successful/cancelled linked outcomes supplied by the originating connection; do not convert APQP to the target PPAP process.

ProjectFwk_Task_Detail (5a653e69-a761-46f0-a507-1df9b5f53895)
Keep the existing Integrated Task definition and workflow. Show the authorized target Task.PPAPs collection and each actual outcome rather than relying on singular RelatedPPAP or treating Cancelled as success.

Build instructions
1. Place the target field/control sections in the current PPAP workspace: source and exact facility/drawing/parts; internal SIA PPAP Engineer and routing; dates/model; required-element work/review; saved evidence and grouped rejection history/count; part masses; approval/certificate and fixed-audience discussion. Use the actual fields and actions already configured by their owning assignments, not duplicate stored lists.
2. Use stage containers to show only valid actions: internal Draft setup/Issue; issued supplier scope confirmation and permitted work; engineer review; selected management approval/return; closed read-only history and authorized PDF/files. A manager return is supplier pending/in progress and its internal comment stays hidden.
3. Remove target usage of all 40 legacy-only PPAP fields/panels, interim weights/completion fields, shared project counters and obsolete level/PSW dependencies without deleting metadata needed by historical records or APQP. Do not use EditReadOnly markup to bypass closed restrictions.
4. Configure native responsive sections/grids, accessible English labels, keyboard navigation, clear validation messages and permission-aware download/navigation links. Keep the same connected browser experience on desktop/tablet/phone; no disconnected mobile application is built.

How to check the result
• The target create screen uses governed scope controls and applies the stated Draft/Issue requirements rather than requiring singular legacy Product/template; historical views remain on their original branch.
• A supplier sees only valid issued work; an SIA engineer sees consolidated element/rejection history and can navigate without opening unrelated source records.
• Closed target records have no interim/withdrawal/edit-read-only action or new discussion post control.

Information needed for this task
IN-14: Supply effective target view/module identifiers and supported responsive view actions if the tenant differs from the package. The actual package names below identify the proposed change locations.

Supplied input context
• IN-14 — Target screens and supported expressions: The technical team must supply supported expressions and view-action methods where this design states business logic rather than executable Intelex syntax, together with the effective tenant view/module identifiers if they differ from the package. Build assignments use the verified package names and must not guess a replacement expression or tenant target.
